name: Misty cuckoo
description: Original synthesized birdsong: a lower, slower two-note cuckoo call; softened highs and a short tail give a sense of distance in morning mist.

zh-Hans.name: 布谷·晨雾
zh-Hans.description: 原创合成仿鸟鸣：较低、较缓的布谷双呼，柔化高频与短余韵营造晨雾距离感。

zh-Hant.name: 布穀·晨霧
zh-Hant.description: 原創合成仿鳥鳴：較低、較緩的布穀雙呼，柔化高頻與短餘韻營造晨霧距離感。
